strategy("Local teaching template - Expected range breakout", overlay=true, initial_capital=10000, commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.10, slippage=1, pyramiding=0)
rangeLength = input.int(20, "Expected range lookback", minval=2)
atrLength = input.int(14, "ATR length", minval=1)
atrMultiple = input.float(1.0, "ATR range multiple", minval=0.1, step=0.1)
tradeMode = input.string("Breakout", "Mode", options=["Breakout", "Mean reversion"])
startTime = input.time(timestamp(2022, 1, 1, 0, 0), "Backtest start")
endTime = input.time(timestamp(2026, 12, 31, 23, 59), "Backtest end")
inWindow = time >= startTime and time <= endTime
basis = ta.sma(close, rangeLength)
width = ta.atr(atrLength) * atrMultiple
upper = basis + width
lower = basis - width
longSignal = tradeMode == "Breakout" ? close > upper : close < lower
flatSignal = tradeMode == "Breakout" ? close < basis : close > basis
if inWindow and longSignal
    strategy.entry("Range long", strategy.long)
if flatSignal or not inWindow
    strategy.close("Range long")
plot(upper, "Expected upper", color=color.green)
plot(basis, "Range basis", color=color.gray)
plot(lower, "Expected lower", color=color.red)

//@version=6
strategy("Local teaching template - Seven EMA fracture threshold", overlay=true, initial_capital=10000, commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.10, slippage=1, pyramiding=0)
threshold = input.int(5, "Trend score threshold", minval=1, maxval=7)
atrLength = input.int(14, "ATR length", minval=1)
stopAtr = input.float(2.0, "Stop ATR multiple", minval=0.1, step=0.1)
riskReward = input.float(1.8, "Reward-to-risk target", minval=0.1, step=0.1)
ema1 = ta.ema(close, 8)
ema2 = ta.ema(close, 13)
ema3 = ta.ema(close, 21)
ema4 = ta.ema(close, 34)
ema5 = ta.ema(close, 55)
ema6 = ta.ema(close, 89)
ema7 = ta.ema(close, 144)
score = (close > ema1 ? 1 : 0) + (ema1 > ema2 ? 1 : 0) + (ema2 > ema3 ? 1 : 0) + (ema3 > ema4 ? 1 : 0) + (ema4 > ema5 ? 1 : 0) + (ema5 > ema6 ? 1 : 0) + (ema6 > ema7 ? 1 : 0)
longSignal = score >= threshold
exitSignal = score < threshold - 2
risk = ta.atr(atrLength) * stopAtr
if longSignal
    strategy.entry("Trend score long", strategy.long)
strategy.exit("Score risk exit", "Trend score long", stop=strategy.position_avg_price - risk, limit=strategy.position_avg_price + risk * riskReward)
if exitSignal
    strategy.close("Trend score long")
plot(score, "Trend score", color=color.teal)
